body.prompt: Medium wide shot inside a large leather Roman command tent at night: the Roman emperor Marcus Aurelius at age fifty-four, lean weathered face, short curly grey-brown hair, short grey-flecked full beard, deep tired eyes, plain brown wool tunic under a deep crimson wool military cloak fastened with a round bronze brooch sitting at the table at left, and the Roman empress Faustina the Younger at about forty-five, elegant tired face, dark hair braided and pinned up, deep blue wool stola, gold earrings standing at the far side of the tent, half in shadow, neither looking at the other, firelight between them. Not a painting, not an illustration. Horizontal 16:9 widescreen frame, main subject in the middle band of the frame, nothing important in the top and bottom eighth of the frame.
